title: Mars Orbiter Mission (MOM) / Mangalyaan
definition: India's first interplanetary mission launched by ISRO to orbit Mars, making India the first nation to reach Martian orbit on its maiden attempt.
importanceInUpsc: Tests India's technological prowess, cost-effective space engineering, and strategic geopolitical positioning in global space exploration.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Mars Orbiter Mission.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basics of Launch Vehicles (PSLV vs GSLV)
